Start my path
Loop engineering · every path

Humans in the loop. Learning in every loop.

Every task runs through the same engineered loop. People approve what matters, every outcome is measured, and what the platform learns makes the next run better.

  1. 01 · AgentsPlanAgents break the goal into tasks against the company plan.
  2. 02 · AgentsActThey draft, build, publish, sell and serve within guardrails.
  3. 03 · HumanReview & approveSpend, customer messages and big calls wait for your yes.
  4. 04 · PlatformMeasureResults, costs and customer replies are tracked automatically.
  5. 05 · PlatformLearnYour edits, approvals and outcomes go into shared memory.
  6. 06 · PlatformImproveAgents and playbooks are updated before the next run.

Step 6 feeds step 1. The loop never stops, and every agent, playbook and guardrail improves with it.

Autonomy is earned

From assisted to autonomous operations.

Each task moves up a level only after it proves itself. You set the limits, and you can step any task back down at any time.

  1. L1AssistAgents draft and recommend. People do the work and decide.
  2. L2ApproveAgents do the work. People approve before anything goes out.
  3. L3AutonomousAgents run within your limits. People handle exceptions and review the daily briefing.
